parameter_refs.name: entry_time_difference_target_s
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: frozen below, inside and above training range targets; actual entry measured independently

quote: When two vehicles enter an intersection from different highways at approximately the same time, the driver of the vehicle on the left shall yield the right-of-way to the vehicle on the right. Except as otherwise provided in subsection 4 [NRS-484B-250-4], this section does not apply at intersections controlled by official traffic-control devices or to vehicles approaching each other from opposite directions, when the driver of one of the vehicles is intending to or is making a left turn.

activation.condition: Two vehicles enter from different highways at an intersection with source-reviewed applicability.

exceptions.description: Official traffic-control-device intersection status requires independent authority review.
exceptions.source_clause: this section does not apply at intersections controlled by official traffic-control devices

exceptions.description: Opposing approach with an intended or actual left turn requires source review.
exceptions.source_clause: or to vehicles approaching each other from opposite directions, when the driver of one of the vehicles is intending to or is making a left turn

exceptions.description: Subsection 4 priority requires independent statutory review.
exceptions.source_clause: Except as otherwise provided in subsection 4 [NRS-484B-250-4]

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: driver of the vehicle on the left

obligation.description: The left vehicle yields to the right vehicle when the source-grounded conditions hold.

timing.description: At the original footprint entry into the reviewed intersection.
